rows.grounds: compound kaula + sadbhāva; accusative singular masculine
imperative of śru, second person singular
adjective describing kaula true nature; accusative singular

items.question: What kaula true nature, consisting of desire-art, is to be heard as nectar?
items.inference: The verse identifies kaula's true nature as desire-art and commands hearing it as nectar.
items.plain_english: Hear as nectar the true nature of kaula, which consists of desire-art.
